title: Origin story: Inti
description: Inti was the sun god of the Inca, father of the first Inca Manco Capac, who emerged from the earth with his siblings to found Cusco. The Sapa Inca ruled as Inti's living son, and the empire's agriculture, festivals, and gold — the sun's sweat — all flowed from his worship.

description: Ranked abilities: Solar power — rank 100/100; Agriculture — rank 98/100; Kingship — rank 96/100; Order — rank 95/100; Benevolence — rank 93/100.

title: Power ranking: Inti
description: Powers: The sun's life-giving light; The golden empire as his temple; The calendar of planting and harvest.

title: Stamina feats: Inti
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Shines over the Andes eternally; Sustained an empire's agriculture.

title: Crossover notes: Inti
description: Inti crosses naturally with: the sun, agriculture, the Inca line.
